about: I write the software a concrete and block plant runs on: cement purchasing, payroll inputs, gate passes, beam quotes, and a camera that counts blocks on the line.
React and TypeScript in front, C# and SQL Server behind, Python when a model has to look at something.

areas.vision: Machine vision on the block line

method: The ERP, the time clock, the spreadsheet being replaced: all of it, before any design.
A median of {medianFiles} files each, so a change can be read and undone.
Nothing goes in while a test is red.
Claude Code and Codex, with skills and hooks I write and measure.
